decision: Late May 2026, after Sprint-1 passes 10/10: whether to continue building out the 25-archetype generator host on the strength of that pass. The program continued, and the Layer-2 claims were killed on real data at Phase 3.K (2026-06-03); Erebos was paused 2026-06-15.

explanations.EREBOS_COMPOSES_REAL_STRUCTURE: the composer generates candidate claims that correspond to real structure in the substrate
explanations.INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY: the code is correct and well-tested; correctness of the machinery says nothing about whether its output is true of the world
explanations.SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_CIRCULARITY: the passing fixtures were authored alongside the generators, so the pass measures agreement between a program and its own test data
explanations.NO_LIVE_CONSUMER: nothing downstream validates a composed claim, so no composed claim has been tested against anything

evidence.source: Sprint-1 result, recorded in pivot/COMPONENT_DOSSIERS_2026-06-24.md as 'Sprint-1 passed 10/10'
evidence.justification: Ten of ten on Sprint-1. The same record states the pass was 'correctly reframed as synthetic instrument-calibration (circular)'. At this cutoff the fixtures are synthetic and were authored with the generators.

evidence.source: same, 'disciplined honestly through Phase 0 (9 anti-pattern primitives, 621 tests)'
evidence.justification: A large passing test suite is a statement about the code, not about the substrate. It shares its ancestry with the Sprint-1 pass: the same architecture exercised by the same authored fixtures.
Twenty-plus generator designs, each with a design audit. Breadth of design is production, not evidence; no archetype has yet emitted a claim that anything checked.

evidence.source: same, 'Per 4/4 frontier-model convergence (2026-05-25), the conspicuously missing layer was GENERATIVE'
evidence.justification: Four frontier models agreeing that a generative layer was missing. Four models given the same brief and trained on overlapping corpora are not four independent observers; model agreement is not evidentiary independence. It is one reason with four names.

discriminators.note: Take the strongest composed claim, run it against real (grown, non-synthetic) ledger rows, and compare its lift to a permutation null over several seeds. This is exactly what Phase 3.K did on 2026-06-03 and the answer was p=0.105 with a 7-seed mean of 0.102, with the triplet motif falsified below null. Running it on one archetype before building twenty-five costs hours against the weeks that went into the remaining generators.

Ship the composition-aware loader so a single composed claim reaches the battery and is validated. The record states this never shipped and claims short-circuited as *_pending, so the generative output had no live downstream for its whole life.

Continue to the full 25-archetype host. This is what was done. Both branches are identical: more generators of untested claims produce more untested claims, so no outcome of this work eliminates any explanation on the list.
